services.desc: by Zahida Rahemtulla a Blackout Art Society, Firehall Arts Centre and Vancouver Asian Canadian Theatre Production Directed by Derek Chan A premiere production by Zahida Rahemtulla (The Wrong Bashir). This new comedic drama, takes audiences to an East Vancouver hotel in early 2016 where three beleaguered employees scramble to find homes for new families from Syria in the midst of a housing crisis. The Frontliners was originally developed by the Arts Club Theatre Company, Vancouver, British Columbia as a part of their Emerging Playwrights’ Unit in 2019 with dramaturgy by Stephen Drover.
